title: NoviceHelper
description: A handy utility mod with a "B" key menu for quick commands, coordinate copying, and automated tool durability alerts.
body:
🛠️ Novice Helper PRO — The Ultimate Survival Companion

Novice Helper PRO is a lightweight yet powerful utility mod designed to make the Minecraft experience smoother for everyone. Whether you are a beginner learning the ropes or a pro looking for a faster way to manage your world, this mod provides a suite of essential tools at your fingertips.
🌟 Key Features

    Quick Access Menu (Key: B): Open a dedicated, clean GUI to instantly control your environment.

    Smart Durability Alerts: Never lose a diamond tool again! The mod monitors your held item and sends chat warnings at 50%, 20%, 10%, and 5% durability.

    Precision Countdown: When your tool is about to break, a real-time countdown appears for the final 5 uses right above your hotbar.

    One-Click Utilities:

        Time & Weather: Change to day/night or clear the rain instantly.

        Gamemodes: Toggle between Creative, Survival, and Spectator modes with one click.

        World Rules: Quickly enable keepInventory or change difficulty.

    Emergency Support: Instant buttons for Night Vision, Healing, and Feeding to save you in tight spots.

    Coordinate Copy: Need to share your base location? Use the "Copy Coords" button to instantly save your X, Y, Z coordinates to your clipboard.

    Entity HP & Hitboxes: Toggle entity hitboxes (F3+B) via the menu and see health points above mobs for better combat.

🌍 Multi-Language Support

The mod is fully localized and professionally translated into:

    English (EN)

    Russian (RU)

    Latvian (LV)

🚀 How to Use

    Open Menu: Press the B key (default) to open the Novice Helper interface.

    Stay Safe: Watch the chat for color-coded warnings when your tools are low on durability.

    Quick Start: Use the "Give Wooden Axe" button to jumpstart your survival adventure!
